    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']

    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', 1.0))
    epsilon = float(extra.get('epsilon', 1e-8))

    delta_lp = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)  # shape: [batch]
    norm_sq = ops.sum(ops.mul(delta_lp, delta_lp))  # scalar
    # Clamp norm to epsilon to avoid division by zero
    norm = ops.sqrt(norm_sq)
    norm_clamped = ops.clamp(norm, epsilon, float('inf'))
    cost_diff = ops.div(delta_lp, norm_clamped)  # stable normalized diff

    adv_diff = ops.clamp(adv_diff_raw, -20.0, 20.0)  # stabilize logits

    scaled_cost = ops.mul(alpha, cost_diff)
    loss_cost = ops.mul(weight, ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(scaled_cost)))

    loss = ops.mean(ops.add(loss_pref, loss_cost))
    return loss

    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    # Compute soft weighting from abs(delta_rank), normalize to [0,1]
    abs_rank = ops.abs(delta_rank)
    max_rank = ops.max(abs_rank)
    # avoid division by zero fallback
    denom = max_rank if max_rank > 0 else 1.0
    w = abs_rank / denom

    # Construct logits for softmax: [log_prob_l, log_prob_w] per pair
    # Index 1 is winner, 0 is loser
    logits = ops.stack([lpl, lpw], dim=1)  # shape (batch_size, 2)

    # Compute log softmax over logits manually: log_softmax(x) = x - log(sum(exp(x)))
    max_logits = ops.max(logits, dim=1, keepdim=True)
    stabilized_logits = ops.sub(logits, max_logits)
    exp_logits = ops.exp(stabilized_logits)
    sum_exp = ops.sum(exp_logits, dim=1, keepdim=True)
    log_softmax = ops.sub(stabilized_logits, ops.log(sum_exp))  # shape (batch_size, 2)

    # Negative log likelihood for winner idx=1
    neg_log_prob_win = -log_softmax[:,1]

    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(w, neg_log_prob_win)
    loss_weighted = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)

    return ops.mean(loss_weighted)
